name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A native modal on an overlay sheet, opened and closed without script.
use: A decision or a short task that must be finished or dismissed before the page is used again: confirm a destructive act, fill a short form. With dialog-drawer it is a side panel for filters, details or navigation; with dialog-sheet it is a panel from the bottom edge on a small screen.

instead.when: The content belongs to one button and the page stays usable around it
It is a list of actions opened from a button
It is one search field over a list of commands
It confirms something that just happened and needs no answer
The message can stay in the page and blocks nothing
The overlay holds one picture and nothing to decide

keyboard.action: On a button with commandfor and command="show-modal": open the dialog and move focus into it, to the element with autofocus when there is one
Move between the controls inside the dialog; the page behind it is inert
Close the dialog and return focus to the button that opened it
In a form with method="dialog": submit it, which closes the dialog and sets its returnValue

platform.feature: commandfor with command="show-modal" and command="close" (invoker commands)
platform.fallback: Call dialog.showModal() and dialog.close() from a click handler; the stylesheet is the same
A click on the scrim does nothing; Escape and the close buttons still close the dialog
The dialog and its scrim appear and leave at once, without the fade

classes.name: dialog
classes.description: The overlay sheet, on a dialog element named with aria-labelledby or aria-label. It is 28rem wide and keeps 1rem clear of the viewport

classes.name: dialog-sm
classes.description: 22rem wide, for a confirmation of one sentence; the default is 28rem

classes.name: dialog-drawer
classes.description: A panel on the inline-end edge, 24rem wide, for work that keeps the page in view. It floats 8px inside the viewport and slides in from the edge it rests on

classes.name: dialog-drawer-start
classes.description: With dialog-drawer: the panel rests on the inline-start edge, 18rem wide, where navigation lives

classes.name: dialog-sheet
classes.description: A panel that rises from the bottom edge, with square lower corners, clear of the home indicator

classes.name: dialog-header
classes.description: Holds the title and the description at the top of the sheet

classes.name: dialog-title
classes.description: The title; point the dialog's aria-labelledby at it

classes.name: dialog-description
classes.description: A quiet sentence under the title that says what the title means

classes.name: dialog-body
classes.description: Content between header and footer. It takes the remaining height and scrolls inside the sheet when it is long

classes.name: dialog-footer
classes.description: The actions, the main one last. Under 22rem of dialog width they stack at full width, the main one first

classes.name: dialog-close
classes.description: Places a quiet square button in the top corner at the inline end; it needs an accessible name

states.name: open
states.description: Set by the browser when the dialog is shown. Do not write it in markup: a dialog that starts with open is not modal

states.name: modal
states.description: Opened with show-modal or showModal(): the page behind it does not scroll
